auth.signInSubtitle: Use your staff account to continue.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.

dashboard.intro: This is your admin home. Sections you have access to are in the menu.

comingSoon.title: {{section}}
comingSoon.body: This section is being built and will appear in a later release.

noAccess.title: No sections yet
noAccess.body: Your account has no permissions assigned. Ask an administrator to give you a role.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You don't have permission to view this page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Your account is temporarily locked — try again later.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: Your account is disabled. Contact an administrator.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

name.invalid: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes, dots or hyphens only.

money.zero: Amount must be greater than zero.

quantity.invalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.

code.invalid: Use A–Z, 0–9, dash, underscore or dot only.

slug.invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens.

validation.placeholdersChanged: Keep every placeholder like {{name}} exactly as in the English text.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Store-wide configuration. Changes are saved immediately and recorded in the audit log.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

provider.title: Automatic translation
provider.description: English is the only language you write in. Arabic is generated automatically by this engine and can be corrected below.
provider.apiKeySet: A key is saved ({{masked}}). Type a new one to replace it.
provider.apiKeyHelp: Only needed if your LibreTranslate server requires keys.
provider.testFailed: The engine did not return a usable translation. Check the address and that the server is running.
provider.testOff: Automatic translation is off. Choose an engine and save first.

storefront.title: Storefront language
storefront.description: How the Arabic version of your website behaves for visitors.
storefront.autoDetectHelp: First-time visitors whose browser prefers Arabic open the Arabic site. Search engines are never redirected.
storefront.digitsHelp: Most Saudi stores use Western digits.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Teach the engine your vocabulary once: words to keep as-is (brands, payment methods) and your preferred translation for common shop terms. Changes apply to new translations; use “Retranslate everything” to update existing ones.

ui.title: Storefront text
ui.description: Website labels translated by the engine. Correct any that are wrong — your version goes live within a minute and is never overwritten. Keep placeholders like {{store}} exactly as they are.

queue.title: Translation status
queue.description: Background translation of products, pages and other content.
queue.providerOff: Automatic translation is off, so new content stays in English until you enable an engine and retry.
queue.unavailable: The job queue is unreachable right now (Redis). Translation will resume automatically.
queue.uiNote: Website labels are generated by developers with “npm run i18n:translate”; correct them in “Storefront text” above.
